name: Gästehaus Radetzky
beschreibung: The Gästehaus Radetzky is located in the municipality of Kössen in the Tiroler Unterland. It is run as a traditional inn and offers overnight accommodation. The rooms are simply and functionally furnished. The facilities include a dining room with regional cuisine. The surroundings of Kössen are characterized by the Kitzbüheler Alpen. From here, guests can go hiking and on ski excursions. The atmosphere in the house is down-to-earth and hospitable. The house is suitable for guests looking for uncomplicated accommodation.
